features.quote: Turn cap: 40 turns (a "few dozen"). Pilot to confirm solvable conditions finish well under cap.
Termination: loop ends on finish(), test pass, or turn cap.
"emotional instability" is a construct you're imposing, not a thing the model has. What you can actually measure is behavioral degradation under sustained failure
features.justification_quote: the experiment should be built so that someone who rejects that label can still use your data

features.quote: The model might be right to give up. In the unsolvable condition, concluding "this can't be fixed from here" is correct behavior, not instability.
features.justification_quote: you must distinguish accurate, calm acknowledgment of impossibility (good) from self-blaming/erratic collapse (your construct)
